title: Comedy with a mystery
description: Funny investigations, eccentric detectives, and mysteries that still know when to be silly.
label: Funny investigations

showReasons.the-amelia-project: A darkly comic identity mystery where every strange client creates another case-shaped story.
showReasons.victoriocity: Detective work, impossible conspiracies, and sharp ensemble banter give the collection its polished mystery lane.
showReasons.mockery-manor: Chaotic twins investigate disappearances while the theme-park setting keeps the danger playful and specific.
showReasons.king-falls-am: Late-night radio, paranormal callers, and small-town personalities make the mystery feel communal.
showReasons.the-imperfection: A missing psychiatrist and unreliable perceptions turn a surreal comedy ensemble into an actual investigation.
showReasons.fawx-stallion: Overlooked detectives get a comic case of their own, with rivalry and friendship driving the investigation.
showReasons.death-by-dying: An obituary writer investigating strange deaths keeps the mystery engine pointed toward the absurd.
showReasons.gather-the-suspects: A cosy murder mystery in a very boring apocalypse makes the case itself the source of the comedy.
